conditional_extension_decision_repeats.purpose: reverse-order repeat; separate denominator, not independent seeds

physical_plan.incomplete_windows: failure/NA, not reduced-sample success; earlier completed original event prioritized

conditional_qualification.native_and_free_reuse: same frozen package and protocol/case ID can be reused; differing identity adds separate actual cases

extension_rule.repeat_order: reverse the first-pass order for all 3 packages x 4 full cases only if extension is plausible
per_warp_side_any_of: treatment worst completed-original-event level over two runs strictly exceeds best event level of each comparator (+0 and zero)
complete fixed window: max(treatment P95) < min(+0 P95) and < min(zero P95), with simultaneous-ready and position-qualified counts not worse
min(treatment longest simultaneous-ready) > max(+0 ready) and > max(zero ready), complete fixed P95 not distinguishably worse than either comparator
extension_rule.native_both_sides: retain approach/park and original event level relative to either comparator; complete fixed window required when comparing error; same-event P95 not distinguishably worse than either comparator
extension_rule.distinguishable_p95_regression: min(treatment P95 over two repeats) > max(comparator P95 over its two repeats)
extension_rule.failure_timing: compare actual task stage/event regression, not absolute ending seconds; faster progression to a later failure is not earlier-stage regression
extension_rule.negative_scope: no demonstrated extra benefit under this parent/config/budget, not a universal claim that XY is useless
extension_rule.project_not_official: budget continuation rule, not author curriculum or changed task threshold

parallel_frozen_fp64.identity: Original u10000, original540dim Actor input; separate process and artifacts from RefXY2.
fixed_inputs: 3 archived FP32 direction vectors, cast toFP64 without reselection
archived noise at every sensor time
preserve: normalizer frozen state with no updates
outputs: endpoint/synchronous error and selected per-step state outputs
algebra_checks: J32=prefix+Critic at value and directional-derivative levels
8 component sum=prefix at value and derivative levels
grad(J32,z) dot archived_direction equals JVP(J32) direction
numerical_checks: Record one-sided and central slopes, absolute/relative errors and adjacent-scale changes.
Look for convergence on at least3 successive scales above empirical cancellation/noise floor; do not require asymptotic order at every scale across unknown nonsmooth points.
Record duplicated-baseline variability and FP64 spacing as empirical resolution information, not rigorous total-error bounds.

If FD converges stably but not toward AD above resolution, localize earliest divergent time/operator/subterm. Do not claim a specific derivative bug until reproducible same-function counterexample is isolated.
If values become unresolved, mark unresolved. Do not count that as a pass.
parallel_frozen_fp64.consequence: A concrete gradient/objective implementation bug requires quarantining affected evidence and handling it separately; do not silently add the fix as a second factor in the RefXY2 comparison. Otherwise retain the unresolved limitation and continue the registered information-only pair, without a new WM validation barrier.
parallel_frozen_fp64.limits: FP64 eager mathematical-function checks do not alone validate compiledFP32 production trajectory or physical backend. No logged switches is not a smoothness certificate.

fp64_extra_requirements.concrete_core_bug: seal affected boundary; identify separate fix before mixing results
fp64_extra_requirements.diagnostic_only_bug: fix diagnostic, do not alter pair training
fp64_extra_requirements.unresolved: retain limitation, no automatic additional physics or optimization
